newsitem.title: SPAIN: Office of ETA political arm attacked in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Office of ETA political arm attacked in Spain.

text.p: Unknown attackers firebombed the seat of ETA's political wing on Saturday, hours after a Spanish politician abducted by the Basque guerrilla group was found shot in the head, state television said.

A strong explosion was heard at the site in the northern Basque town of Ermua, where abducted politician Miguel Angel Blanco is councillor for the ruling Popular Party. There were no reports of injuries.
Firefighters put out the flames in a matter of minutes, and the damage shown on state television did not appear to be serious.
The attack followed a day of noisy but peaceful demonstrations near the Ermua office of Herri Batasuna, which acts as the political arm of the ETA rebel movement.
Police had tried to keep townspeople, outraged at the attempt on Blanco's life, from approaching the office.
Blanco, 29, was clinging to life in hospital in the Basque coastal city of San Sebastian after he was found shot in the head in a wooded area on Saturday afternoon.
